name: 祖宗饶命
detailed_description:
In this environment where money fills the whole world,The hero in order to obtain more wealth,Done the business of robbing the tomb,The horror of the tomb robbery and seeing the various treasures in the tomb,Let the hero be ecstatic,Expanding day by day,But with the continuous tomb robbery,The accumulated resentment value is getting heavier and heavier,Resulting in the hero,Every time the night comes,,To be tormented by demons and monsters,The hero continues not to spend a lot of money to buy soul charms to resist their attacks,Waiting for the second coming,Cycle after cycle, I don't know how many dawns the protagonist can usher in.

The game is a 2D pixel wind game, making many treasures in the ancient tombs, there are detection tools in the game, you can find more advanced tombs, there is excavation work, you can improve the explosion rate of items after the successful tomb robbery, there are combat tools, you can quickly solve the monsters that may appear at any time, there are lighting tools, you can provide a wider field of vision, there are protective tools, you can improve stronger defense capabilities, and many tools can be purchased with gold coins from ghost market merchants. In a terrifying and tense atmosphere, I hope to bring a different game experience to all players.
